start: ^I also explored 2D platformer level design in this project, specifically for the lava and spikes hazard levels.
^Want to hear about the design philosophy behind it?
technical_detail: ^It was an interesting design experience because I had to build levels around a core mechanic where the player has a limited amount of time to stay alive.
^I had to strategically place healing pickups and obstacles in a specific way that plays with the player's perceived sense of urgency, forcing them to take risks.
